# Review Copilot customisation

Review the repository's current Copilot customisation against the Instruction Architect principles and make useful improvements if they are justified.

Focus on whether the current setup:

- keeps global guidance genuinely global
- uses `applyTo` instructions only when the guidance is truly path-specific
- keeps skills, prompts, and agents focused and justified
- avoids duplication and trivially discoverable content
- preserves useful existing repository knowledge
- stays low-maintenance and human-readable
- avoids unnecessary customisation when no real benefit exists

If changes are useful, make the smallest effective improvement. If not, leave the repository unchanged.
